observed_value: issuer_name values include category and instrument terms, e.g. 'Debt Investments Human Resource Support Services Madcap Software, Inc. First-lien loan ($32,256 par, due 12/2026) Initial Acquisition Date 12/15/2023 Reference Rate and Spread SOFR + 6.10% Interest Rate 10.35%'
anchor_value: The raw SOI has a separate Company column with clean issuer names and a separate Investment column with instrument terms.

findings.detail: C206 is a real issuer_name parse leak: extracted issuer_name cells combine section labels, clean issuer, investment terms, dates, spread, and rate even though the SOI presents issuer and terms in separate columns.

rationale: Class 1 single-cell adjudication. The flagged column is issuer_name, but the observed values in the bundle include raw schedule path and investment terms. The raw Schedule of Investments rows cited above show the Company/issuer cell is clean, while investment description, acquisition date, reference spread, and interest rate are separate cells. Therefore the flag identifies a real extraction/column-mapping defect rather than a valid issuer name or bad check.
